items.title: Windows上のgitコマンド速度向上
items.description: Improved the speed of many git commands Claude Code runs for itself on Windows; on every platform, errors from those commands now show in English even when git is set to another language

items.title: フックモジュールのネスト深さエラー改善
items.description: Improved the error when a hooks module is nested too deep to load: it now names the file instead of showing a bare stack-overflow message

items.title: ディスク容量不足時のメッセージ改善
items.description: Improved disk-full handling: a Bash command cut off by a full disk now says so and names the folder to free up, and starting on a full temp volume prints a clear message, not a raw ENOSPC error

items.title: /claude-api スキルでAPIトレース追加
items.description: Improved the /claude-api skill to offer API tracing alongside SDK tracing when asked to add OpenTelemetry

items.title: /claude-api スキルでライブドキュメント確認
items.description: Improved the /claude-api skill to check the live docs before saying a feature is unsupported

items.title: dataviz スキルがAPCAをサポート
items.description: Updated the bundled dataviz skill to accept APCA as a text-contrast measure (keeping WCAG 2 ratios where AA conformance is required), add an `apca(text, background)` function to its palette validator scripts, and say whether a label inside a colored chart fill should be white or near‑black

items.title: /claude-api スキルでOpenTelemetry管理が可能に
items.description: Updated the /claude-api skill: service account keys and Workload Identity Federation tokens can now manage OpenTelemetry destinations

items.title: Linux サンドボックスの書き込み許可解除バグ修正
items.description: Linux: Fixed sandbox write denies lifting when a background command outlived the session

items.title: Windows PowerShell の cd 権限チェック修正
items.description: Windows: Fixed PowerShell permission checks auto-approving some `Set-Location` or `cd` commands that target the current directory and carry extra arguments; these now prompt for approval

items.title: macOS の開発者ツールダイアログ修正
items.description: macOS: Fixed the "Install Command Line Developer Tools" dialog opening each time Claude Code starts on a Mac without Xcode or the Command Line Tools

items.title: Self‑hosted runner の起動タイムアウトバグ修正
items.description: Self-hosted runner: Fixed `--startup-timeout-min` stopping a session whose first prompt, such as `/code-review`, was still working in a subagent; a frozen process is still stopped

items.title: ランナーモードでの中断ツール呼び出し表示改善
items.description: Self-hosted runner: Improved sessions that move to a new runner: Claude now sees the tool call that was interrupted, marked as outcome unknown

items.title: `sed -i` の標準Bashプロンプト取得へ変更
items.description: Changed `sed -i` to get the standard Bash prompt and run as written, not a simulated file-edit preview; like other Bash edits, it is no longer restored by `/rewind`

items.title: `claude ultrareview` のワークスペース信頼要求
items.description: Changed `claude ultrareview` to require workspace trust: it asks on a terminal, else refuses; scripts pass `--trust-workspace`, which takes no value (put a PR number or base branch before it), or set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRAREVIEW_TRUST_CHECK=1`

items.title: デスクトップ/VS Code の危険な rm/rmdir プロンプト変更
items.description: Changed the dangerous `rm` and `rmdir` prompt in bypass permissions mode in the Desktop app and VS Code to deny the command at once with a rewrite hint, so unattended sessions keep going

items.title: サンドボックス除外設定の書き込み前確認変更
items.description: Changed commands the settings exclude from the sandbox to ask before writing to its write-list paths while the sandbox is enabled but cannot run; the unsandboxed fallback is refused there

items.title: worktree 作成時のオンデマンドフェッチ停止
items.description: Changed worktree creation and reuse so git no longer fetches objects on demand, in ordinary clones and in partial clones with a Bash sandbox configured; such a partial clone fetches them first

items.title: /claude‑api スキルで Managed Agents のデフォルト設定変更
items.description: Changed the `/claude-api` skill to build Managed Agents subagent teams on `multiagent_20261001` with dynamic workflows on by default, instead of `coordinator`

items.title: VS Code で証明書検証失敗の警告ロギング追加
items.description: [VSCode] Added a log warning that says what to do when dictation or the extension's own requests fail certificate verification, such as behind a TLS‑inspecting proxy

items.title: VS Code の Claude パネル空白バグ修正
items.description: [VSCode] Fixed the Claude panel staying blank after the editor cached an incomplete copy of its files; it now recovers by itself, or says what went wrong and how to fix it

items.title: VS Code セッション履歴の空セッション生成バグ修正
items.description: [VSCode] Fixed Session history filling up with empty "Untitled" sessions each time you start a new session without sending a message

items.title: VS Code の長いスラッシュコマンドメッセージ折りたたみ
items.description: [VSCode] Fixed long slash-command messages such as `/goal` filling the chat panel; they now fold behind Show more like other prompts (anthropics/claude-code#97469)

items.title: チャットパネル狭窄時のメッセージ折りたたみバグ修正
items.description: [VSCode] Fixed long messages not folding behind Show more after the chat panel is made narrower

items.title: Ctrl+J の改行挿入挙動変更
items.description: [VSCode] Fixed Ctrl+J in the chat input always inserting a newline: it is now left to VS Code and the OS when "ctrl+j" is set to null in the Chat context of ~/.claude/keybindings.json

items.title: プラグインラベル描画バグ修正
items.description: [VSCode] Fixed a mod's "From the … plugin" label above the prompt being drawn over the slash command and @‑mention menus (anthropics/claude-code#102981)

items.title: LaTeX 貼り付け時のリストリセットバグ修正
items.description: [VSCode] Fixed an empty list item, paragraph or code block, and list items renumbered from 1, when pasting copied LaTeX math

items.title: 組織がフィードバック受け付けない場合のエラー表示修正
items.description: [VSCode] Fixed the feedback error showing only an HTTP status when your organization does not accept feedback

items.title: VS Code の編集・書き込み速度改善
items.description: [VSCode] Improved Edit and Write speed in the chat panel: the wait for new problems after each edit is now 0.75 seconds in most cases, down from 1 to 1.5 seconds

items.title: Cloud セッションのコネクタリストローディングバグ修正
items.description: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the Add connector list in routine forms saying no connectors were available while they were still loading

items.title: Cloud 環境エディタの変数エスケープバグ修正
items.description: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the cloud environment editor shuffling environment variables and adding backslashes to values that contain both kinds of quote

items.title: Cloud 環境詳細ダイアログのレイアウト修正
items.description: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the self-hosted environment details dialog in admin settings so its title, tabs and buttons stay in view while only the content scrolls

items.title: Cloud セッションのドキュメントツール表示バグ修正
items.description: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the "read documentation" tool row in cloud sessions, which showed escaped JSON instead of a readable page

items.title: Cloud セッションの Changes ペイン情報改善
items.description: [Cloud sessions] Improved a cloud session's Changes pane, which now says when it lists only pushed commits or only Claude's edits

items.title: Slack タグでの DM 誤送信修正
items.description: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack posting a draft you approved for a channel into your DM by mistake; a post with no channel is now refused so it can go to the approved channel

items.title: Slack の承認カード操作バグ修正
items.description: [Claude Tag] Fixed Allow and Deny on Claude's approval cards in Slack doing nothing when the session had stopped; your answer now restarts the session

items.title: Slack ワークスペース変更後のメッセージ無視バグ修正
items.description: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude ignoring untagged messages in a Slack channel after its workspace moved to a different Claude organization, including unshared channels on Enterprise Grid

items.title: Slack スレッド返信順序バグ修正
items.description: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in a Slack channel posting a threaded reply before reading a newer message someone had just added to that thread

items.title: Slack 管理設定でのワークスペース表示バグ修正
items.description: [Claude Tag] Fixed the Slack page in Claude Tag admin settings saying no workspaces were connected when the list failed to load; it now shows an error with a Retry button

items.title: Code Review の完了チェックバグ修正
items.description: [Code Review] Fixed a finished review showing no check on the pull request when earlier tries to create it failed; a final try now adds a completed check

items.title: Code Review のプッシュキュー停止バグ修正
items.description: [Code Review] Fixed a push queued behind a running review still starting a review after `@claude review stop`; its check now closes and says why

items.title: macOS/Linux の Bash サンドボックス起動ファイル実行バグ修正
items.description: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands on macOS and Linux running the shell's startup files outside the sandbox before each command

items.title: macOS サンドボックス denyWrite パターンのシンボリックリンク処理修正
items.description: Fixed macOS sandbox `denyWrite` glob patterns not applying at a path's real location when the pattern's folder is reached through a symlink

items.title: --mcp-config での MCP 設定改変バグ修正
items.description: Fixed sandboxed commands and auto-accepted edits being able to modify the MCP config file passed with `--mcp-config`

items.title: 無効化された MCP サーバーの再接続バグ修正
items.description: Fixed a disabled MCP server being reconnected by a later permission prompt in print and SDK sessions

items.title: Bash 権限チェックでの変数信頼バグ修正
items.description: Fixed the Bash permission check trusting a variable set by a command whose redirect can fail to open

items.title: Bash 権限チェックでの cd 複合コマンド非表示バグ修正
items.description: Fixed Bash permission checks not prompting for some compound commands that change directory before running git when the `cd` is wrapped or prefixed, as they do for a plain `cd`

items.title: Edit(path) ルールのリダイレクト遮断バグ修正
items.description: Fixed an `Edit(path)` deny rule not blocking a Bash redirect to that path in some commands that also held a subshell

items.title: worktree 隔離セッションのロケールコマンド受容バグ修正
items.description: Fixed worktree-isolated sessions accepting some locale-prefixed commands the isolation guard should refuse

items.title: zsh の算術コマンド受容バグ修正
items.description: Fixed worktree-isolated sessions on zsh accepting some arithmetic commands that the isolation guard should refuse

items.title: git replace refs の無視バグ修正
items.description: Fixed worktrees and branch checkouts that Claude Code creates so they ignore git replace refs, as its other git operations already do

items.title: シンボリックリンク経由のプロファイルストア保護バグ修正
items.description: Fixed profile store write protection not applying when the config directory is reached through a symlink

items.title: 大容量ネスト CLAUDE.md の読み込み最適化
items.description: Fixed sessions compacting repeatedly after reading files under a very large nested CLAUDE.md; a nested CLAUDE.md over the size limit now loads only its start

items.title: Ctrl+Enter のキューイングタイミング修正
items.description: Fixed ctrl+enter (send now) only queuing a message when pressed before the response had started, and restarting a prompt's hooks while leaving the message queued when pressed while those hooks were running

items.title: `!` モードでのスラッシュコマンド実行バグ修正
items.description: Fixed key-bound slash commands running in the shell from `!` mode

items.title: Ctrl+O のメッセージ表示バグ修正
items.description: Fixed ctrl+o not showing messages from other agents and sessions that are still waiting to be delivered; they now appear in full under the transcript, marked as waiting

items.title: ツール出力プレビューの絵文字切断バグ修正
items.description: Fixed long tool output previews being cut through an emoji, leaving session transcripts that `jq` could not parse

items.title: Linux サンドボックスの PDF 範囲報告バグ修正
items.description: Fixed Read reporting "File does not exist" for PDF page ranges in Linux sandboxes that share the parent's `/proc`

items.title: Desktop ホストセッションのメッセージ欠損修正
items.description: Fixed messages from a Claude Desktop-hosted session sometimes being lost when its connection refreshed

items.title: 異なるアカウントでのデスクトップセッション機能欠如修正
items.description: Fixed features missing from Claude Code sessions in the Claude desktop app when the terminal on the same computer was signed in to a different account or organization

items.title: `claude remote-control` のブランチ表示バグ修正
items.description: Fixed the `claude remote-control` status line showing `HEAD` as the branch for a folder that is not in a git repository

items.title: 分割ペインエージェントのツール制限継承バグ修正
items.description: Fixed split-pane agent teammates not inheriting the tool deny and `--tools` rules given on the leader's command line

items.title: /rename 後の名前表示バグ修正
items.description: Fixed sessions renamed with `/rename` appearing to other sessions under a generated name after a VS Code window reload or a non-interactive `--resume`

items.title: /rewind リストのコード変更表示バグ修正
items.description: Fixed the `/rewind` list showing "No code changes" for a turn that changed checkpointed files through `/code-review --fix`, a subagent or a shell command

items.title: /privacy-settings のヘルプ表示バグ修正
items.description: Fixed `/privacy-settings` showing an out-of-date "Help improve our AI models" value; it now also says when the setting can't be fetched

items.title: フィードバックエラーの詳細表示修正
items.description: Fixed feedback saying "try again later" when your organization does not accept feedback; it now shows the server's reason and where to report a bug

items.title: 大容量 /feedback レポート再送信修正
items.description: Fixed oversized /feedback reports failing instead of being resent without the transcript

items.title: スキル名衝突時のフォルダ表示修正
items.description: Fixed a skill in an `--add-dir` folder being unreachable when another skill already held its name; it is now offered as `<folder>:<name>`

items.title: /verify と /code-review のネストパッケージ検索バグ修正
items.description: Fixed `/verify` and `/code-review` not finding a nested package's own skill when its files were changed from the shell

items.title: /claude-api の trace context バグ修正（ant beta）
items.description: Fixed the /claude-api skill saying that `ant beta:worker poll --on-work` passes trace context to the command

items.title: /claude-api の C# トレース設定バグ修正
items.description: Fixed the /claude-api skill's C# tracing setup missing spans from the cloud platform clients

items.title: AWS 上の API スパン結合バグ修正
items.description: Fixed the /claude-api skill saying that API spans for requests to Claude Platform on AWS can't join the caller's trace

items.title: PowerShell フックの非ブロックバグ修正
items.description: Fixed hooks that run in PowerShell not blocking when the hook's program exits with code 2, and on Windows `PreToolUse` and `PermissionRequest` hooks with `"shell": "powershell"` failing open when Git for Windows isn't installed

items.title: turn.step フックのモデルエイリアスバグ修正
items.description: Fixed a mod's `turn.step` hook that names a model by alias, such as `haiku`, failing every request with a model error: the alias now resolves to its model

items.title: ディスク読取エラー後のプラグイン削除バグ修正
items.description: Fixed plugins and skills synced from claude.ai being removed, sometimes mid-session, after a disk read error

items.title: アーティファクト公開のページバグ修正
items.description: Fixed artifact publishes and updates being refused for some ordinary pages, such as pages with certain minified scripts or artifacts Claude could not read first

items.title: アーティファクト更新時の権限要求バグ修正
items.description: Fixed Claude asking for permission on each artifact update for the rest of a turn after the conversation was compacted in that turn

items.title: Bedrock でのツールストリーミングバグ修正
items.description: Fixed fine-grained tool streaming staying off on Amazon Bedrock when `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL` is set to the default `bedrock-runtime.<region>.amazonaws.com` endpoint

items.title: API 応答待ちヒントのフリッカー修正
items.description: Fixed the "Waiting for API response" hint flickering behind gateways that send only keepalive pings: routes off Anthropic's backend now wait 45 seconds

items.title: GitHub 通知の誤メンションバグ修正
items.description: Fixed Claude notifying unrelated GitHub users by writing role names and placeholders as mentions in PRs, issues and comments
